descriptorDiscoveryAndSelection: Assessed platform/restricted root construction, directory stopping rules, extension-parent merging, offered/suppressed versions, project-over-engine precedence, defaults, command-line precedence, receipt/project/default roots, optional dependencies and platform/target/configuration/Program/module filters.

The recursive descriptor inventory is broader than the runtime discovery result: discovery can stop beneath a directory containing a descriptor, and extension descriptors are merged rather than treated as independent ordinary plugins. Catalog membership therefore supplies no universal discovery or activation claim.

All1561 reference occurrences were mapped with exact source names and selector attributes. No requested Version or TargetsToExplicitlyLoad reference was present in this raw graph. Absence was retained.

startupAndExplicitLoading: Complete BODY094 was assessed, including PreInitPostStartupScreen and LoadStartupModules. Physical982-1009 dispatches PreDefault, Default and PostDefault, project before plugins, with short-circuit failure returns.
Normal enabled-plugin dispatch excludes ExplicitlyLoaded plugins. Selected or enabled membership therefore does not imply normal module startup for those plugins.

Explicit mount/load, phase iteration, version selection, localization and unload behavior were assessed. The public default at physical2179 and private default at physical5220 are both exactly ELoadingPhase::Max.

MountExplicitlyLoadedPlugin can return true after calling the void external mount routine; module-load attempts inside that route do not collectively propagate their failures as the mount boolean. A successful mount return does not establish that every module loaded.
